# galaxie

> A browser-first agent runtime for reviewed, bundled agents, with host-owned capabilities, model routing and UI. Code is AGPL-3.0-only; closed-source use requires a commercial license.

- [Project brief](docs/galaxie-project-brief.md): scope and architecture.

- [Root coding guidance](AGENTS.md): repository rules.
- [Commercial license](COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.md): closed-source use.
